selection_rule: Long-response arm's validation-selected checkpoint; no test-based selection or retuning
test_exclusion_rule: Responses shorter than one full block or exact duplicates of existing train/validation or earlier test responses; report every exclusion
test_gate: Macro consecutive correct NEW >=2/7 and >=1/7 in each domain
arithmetic: Long verified rollouts FP32 on stored BF16 target weights; test teacher and trajectory evaluation BF16 as in validation
